posts.hook: A bot just closed 948 ways to take over Linux machines
posts.caption: openai says an ai pipeline patched 948 linux root bugs, voters passed 38 of 44 data center curbs, russia-linked hackers hit phones via patched flaws. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI says its pipeline found and patched ==948== Linux root bugs for $1.2M
slides.desc: Bug hunting becomes a batch job; merging fixes is the new bottleneck.

terms.gloss: full administrator control of a computer

slides.title: Voters passed 38 of 44 data center restriction measures
slides.desc: Mostly hits projects planned for 2028, not ones already approved.

slides.title: Russia-linked hackers hit phones through already-patched flaws
slides.desc: Lookalike sites stole cookies and Wi-Fi passwords; updating is the defense.

slides.title: White House staff devices were renting out their internet address
slides.desc: Bundled proxy software gave outsiders 236 exits from a secured network.

terms.gloss: a relay that lets others route traffic through your connection

slides.title: Cat Wu, Claude Code's product lead, is joining OpenAI
slides.desc: The rival now employs the person who shaped its closest competitor.

slides.title: Qualcomm bets on data centers as phone sales fall about 20%
slides.desc: It forecasts $5B in data center revenue by the end of 2027.
